To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the martian cratering record is consistent with the impact theory of crater origin and that the martian surface has been exposed to a high density of impactors for the past 3.6 billion years.
fresh martian crater diameters of 0.5 to 5.0 km are characterized by a power law relationship between the frequency of occurrence of a given feature and the diameter of the crater.

fresh martian crater rim crest sharpness and crater-related features such as ejecta blankets and terraced walls occur at diameters that are significantly larger than on the Moon and Mercury and that the onset diameters of these features are significantly larger than the onset diameter of the fresh crater rim crest.
